name: HC Worlds edition
summary: B0aty's route adapted for Hardcore Worlds (launched 4 November 2026): one life and normal XP rates, but you're not an Ironman. You can trade and use the Grand Exchange, in a separate economy that started from zero.
notes: '''Real deaths here, though safe for a normal HCIM:''' Barbarian Assault, the Camelot training room (Knight Waves), Chambers of Xeric, the Dream World in Lunar Diplomacy, Fishing Trawler, Inferno, Magic Training Arena, Nightmare Zone, Pest Control, PvM Arena, TzHaar Fight Cave, random events, the Rogues' Den maze, and dying inside a player-owned house.

'''Still safe:''' Castle Wars, Clan Wars, Soul Wars, TzHaar Fight Pit, Emir's Arena, the Koschei fight in The Fremennik Trials, the Galvek and Glough replays, the Karamja Elite Fight Cave resurrection and the Western Provinces Elite Zulrah resurrection.
'''If you die''' you choose Reset (wipe the character and start again) or Transfer (leave for the main game for good). Either way, anything that would go to your gravestone is deleted.

'''Escape crystals''' cost 10k from Death, Rick in the Wizards' Tower or the Mysterious Stranger, and you start with one. They can only teleport you out of raids, Barbarian Assault, Pest Control, the Inferno and similar activities, and only while in your inventory. Worn and configured, they act like a ring of life everywhere else.
Last Man Standing and Bounty Hunter are disabled, so B0aty's LMS tips are struck out.

'''Money in a new economy.''' Prices here started from zero on 4 November and will move a lot. There's no live price feed for these worlds yet, so MONEY notes say what to check, not what something is worth. Look at the Grand Exchange before you commit.

'''What tends to pay early:''' (1) items NPC shops sell at a fixed price that players pay more for on the GE, like runes: buy, hop, sell, though with only 30 Hardcore worlds shop stock is limited; (2) supplies every new account needs, like herbs, bars, cannonballs, logs and planks; (3) rare drops like Moons of Peril gear, Barrows pieces, crystal seeds and Zulrah uniques. These are worth the most in the first weeks and drop as more players get there, so sell spares quickly.
Risky but valuable content stays in, marked DANGER. Whether to do it is your call.
This edition only changes what the new rules force, what trading makes clearly better, and where money can be made. Everything else is B0aty's route, and it keeps updating from his wiki page.

edits.find: Do all Random Events except
edits.warn: Random events count as real deaths on Hardcore Worlds. None of them involve combat any more, but poison and venom keep ticking inside them, so don't accept one while poisoned or on low HP.

edits.find: This guide DOES NOT include any LMS
edits.why: Last Man Standing is disabled on Hardcore Worlds.

edits.find: Early revenants
edits.warn: Revenants are deep in the Wilderness. PKers on Hardcore Worlds are hunting permanent kills, and a PvP death keeps only 3 items. Very high risk.

edits.find: LMS Rune Arrows
edits.why: LMS is disabled on Hardcore Worlds.

edits.find: You can sell rune arrows to the Market Seller
edits.why: Only applied to LMS rune arrows.

edits.find: Throughout play ALL lamps go to Herblore
edits.tip: Here you can buy herbs and secondaries on the Grand Exchange, so 70 Herblore isn't the brick wall it is for Ironmen. Lamps on Herblore still help, but buying supplies may beat herb runs. Check prices first.

edits.find: All Settings -> Disable level-up
before: In Death's Office: talk to [[Death (NPC)|Death]] to accept the challenge, then hop to a Hardcore World
Take your free [[Escape crystal]]. Right-click, then Configure: wear it as a ring of life for normal play, and turn on the auto-teleport for when you go AFK and take damage
edits.why: Hardcore Worlds characters start in Death's Office with one free escape crystal.

edits.find: Once you have 10,000GP from Floor 3
edits.tip: After a Reset, the Stronghold of Security coins have a 3-day cooldown, so a reset character may not get these 10k straight away.

edits.find: sell all 28 at once
after: Next time you pass Death's Office or the Wizards' Tower, buy 1–2 spare [[Escape crystal]]s (10k each). Never run out
edits.why: Escape crystals cost only 10k here and are your safety net.

edits.find: Raise Kittens as much as you want
edits.tip: LMS is disabled here. Death runes are also on the Grand Exchange, so check the price before committing to cat raising.

edits.find: Talk to Mage of Zamorak in Wilderness
edits.warn: Wilderness: PvP death rules apply, and you'd keep only 3 items before Reset or Transfer. Bring only what this step needs, check for PKers, and be quick.

edits.find: take the Lever to the Wilderness
edits.warn: Wilderness again. Look for PKers before pulling the lever and carry nothing you can't lose.

edits.find: Minigame teleport to Last Man Standing/Clan Wars
edits.tip: LMS itself is disabled. If its teleport option is missing, use Clan Wars, which goes to the same place (Ferox Enclave). Stay inside the Enclave, because outside it is the Wilderness.

edits.find: unlock Barbarian Assault teleport
edits.tip: Only playing Barbarian Assault is a real death. Visiting the area and unlocking the teleport is fine.

edits.find: You can't die in the fights!
edits.warn: That's true for a normal HCIM, but this quest isn't on the Hardcore Worlds safe list. Play the fights as if a death counts: full HP, food, and leave if it goes wrong.

edits.find: Enter Fight Caves & wait for Wave 1
edits.warn: The Fight Cave is a real death on Hardcore Worlds. Wave 1 is weak, but go in at full HP and leave as soon as the wave starts.

edits.find: Rogues' Den to buy Graceful legs
edits.tip: Buying from Grace in the Rogues' Den is fine. Only the Rogues' Den maze is a real death.

edits.find: Buy 1,200 Nature Runes, 500 Law Runes
edits.tip: Runes are also on the Grand Exchange. Use whichever is cheaper.

edits.find: Do alchemy room until 51 Magic
edits.warn: The Mage Training Arena is a real death on Hardcore Worlds. The Alchemy, Telekinetic and Enchantment rooms have nothing that hurts you, but falling bones in the Graveyard room do damage, so keep your HP up there.

edits.find: Go out on the Fishing Trawler
edits.warn: Fishing Trawler is on the real-death list here. Nothing attacks you, so the risk is very low.

edits.find: THIS IS WHERE YOU HIT 750 TOTAL FOR LMS
edits.why: LMS is disabled on Hardcore Worlds.

edits.find: Telegrab a Skull from the Wilderness
edits.warn: Low Wilderness: watch for PKers and don't bring anything you can't lose.

edits.find: IF GP is no issue (LMS/Early revs) You can buy a Cannon
edits.tip: Here the cannon only depends on your gold: cannonballs and bars can be bought and sold on the Grand Exchange.

edits.find: Head into Rogues Den
edits.tip: Just the den with the fire, not the maze (the maze is a real death here).

edits.find: make a raid party on the Notice Board
edits.warn: Chambers of Xeric is a real death on Hardcore Worlds (unlike for HCIM). Keep your escape crystal in your inventory (not worn) so it can pull you out, and only do the first-room CAs you're comfortable with.

edits.find: Minigame Teleport to Pest Control
edits.tip: Only playing Pest Control is a real death. Teleporting to the outpost is fine.

edits.in: Complete these skills whenever you want
edits.find: 70 Construction - Teak Logs from Kingdom
edits.tip: With trading, buy oak and teak planks on the Grand Exchange instead of the Kingdom-logs route.

edits.in: Complete these skills whenever you want
edits.find: 70 Herblore - Do as many herbruns
edits.tip: You can buy herbs, unfinished potions and secondaries on the Grand Exchange and make potions directly. That's far faster than herb runs if you can afford it.

edits.find: Buy a Dragon Scimitar at Ape Atoll
edits.tip: Dragon scimitars are on the Grand Exchange too, so no greegree trip needed.

edits.find: Complete Fire Cape if you're confident
edits.warn: A Fight Cave death is a real death here (only the Karamja Elite resurrection is safe). Go in fully prepared and practised, or leave it for later.

edits.find: Fight Caves Veteran
edits.warn: This means completing the Fight Caves, which is a real death risk.

edits.find: Facing Jad Head-on
edits.warn: Melee-only Fight Caves: extra risk on a one-life account.

edits.find: A Near Miss
edits.warn: This CA means taking a Jad hit without praying. Not recommended on a one-life account.

edits.find: Armoured Zombies drop the Zombie Axe
edits.tip: Zombie axes are tradeable, so you can just buy one on the Grand Exchange. LMS (for Ice Sacks) is disabled, and the Hardcore world list has no PvP worlds, so the PvP-world method doesn't apply.

edits.find: SCOUT THE LADDER WITH AN ALT
edits.why: Only for the PvP-world method, which doesn't exist on Hardcore Worlds.

edits.find: remember to change off PvP world if you bank
edits.why: Only for the PvP-world method, which doesn't exist on Hardcore Worlds.

edits.find: Complete Knight Waves
edits.warn: Knight Waves (the Camelot training room) is a real death on Hardcore Worlds. It's needed for Chivalry and Piety, so go in at full HP with food, flinch carefully, and leave if it goes wrong.

edits.find: Jad Challenges;
edits.warn: Treat TzHaar-Ket-Rak's challenges as a real death risk on a one-life account.

edits.find: Chambers of Xeric: (No Falling Rocks
edits.warn: Chambers of Xeric is a real death on Hardcore Worlds.

edits.find: Complete barrows until you have Tank helm, Plate, Legs
edits.tip: Barrows pieces are tradeable, so you can buy the ones you're missing on the Grand Exchange.

edits.find: Once you have your Bow of Faerdhinen
edits.tip: Enhanced crystal weapon seeds and crystal armour seeds are tradeable. Buying them can replace a long Gauntlet grind.

edits.find: Complete Lunar Diplomacy
edits.warn: The Dream World fight at the end of this quest is a real death on Hardcore Worlds (it's safe for HCIM). Prepare properly before the final fight.

edits.find: Complete the Inferno
edits.warn: Inferno deaths are real on Hardcore Worlds. Keep your escape crystal in your inventory (not worn) so it can teleport you out.

edits.find: while doing Fishing Trawler for Angler Outfit
edits.warn: Fishing Trawler is on the real-death list here (low risk, no combat).

edits.find: Calculate your crafting supplies required via molten glass
edits.tip: Molten glass is tradeable. Buying it can replace the sand mining and Superglass Make.

edits.find: Sell Chaos & Death Runes for Onyx
edits.tip: You can buy onyx and zenyte shards on the Grand Exchange instead, if the price is right.

edits.find: Once you have a ring of suffering
edits.warn: A Zulrah death is real on Hardcore Worlds unless you have the Western Provinces Elite diary resurrection.

edits.find: CoX until Prayer Scrolls
edits.warn: Chambers of Xeric is a real death on Hardcore Worlds.

edits.find: Some optional methods to make early fast GP
edits.money: On Hardcore Worlds, add: rune-shop stock resold on the GE, farm-run herbs, cannonballs (after Dwarf Cannon), and spare drops from Moons of Peril, Barrows and Zulrah. MONEY notes point these out as you reach them.

edits.find: buy 1x Fire/Air/Earth Pack
edits.money: Shop to GE: Aubury's runes have a fixed shop price. If the GE price is clearly higher, buy extra packs, hop worlds and sell. The same works at every rune shop later in the guide.

edits.find: sell all 28 at once
edits.money: Check the GE first. Eclipse reds are tradeable, and early on players may pay more than Antonius does.

edits.find: This should net you over 1,000,000GP
edits.money: Pyramid tops are sold to an NPC at a fixed price, so this pays the same here, and 1M goes much further in a new economy.

edits.find: Buy 400 Chaos Runes from Aubury
edits.money: If chaos runes sell for well over Aubury's price on the GE, buy extra while you're here.

edits.find: Unlock both Rune Stores
edits.money: Ali's two rune stores are the best shop-to-GE stop in this part of the guide: nature, law, cosmic and death runes. Check the margin and buy extra while you're here.

edits.find: AT THIS POINT YOU SHOULD PRIORITISE MEDIUM CONTRACTS
edits.money: Herb runs double as money. Every new account needs herbs, so sell the ones you don't need (high-level herbs like ranarr and snapdragon especially).

edits.find: Complete Dwarf Cannon
edits.money: You can now smith cannonballs from steel bars (35 Smithing). Everyone with a cannon needs them, which makes them a classic early-economy seller. Check the margin over steel bars.

edits.find: IF YOU ARE PLANNING TO USE MISCELLNIA
edits.money: Here you can also sell Miscellania's herbs and logs, so the kingdom can pay for itself. Compare its output with the upkeep.

edits.find: Complete Tempoross until 65 Fishing
edits.money: Keep the reward-pool loot. Fish and supplies sell, and early buyers pay well.

edits.find: Set up Miscellania with the information below
edits.money: If money matters more than XP, set Miscellania to whatever sells best (check herb and log prices) and sell the output.

edits.find: Solo Wintertodt until you get 12+ Magic Logs
edits.money: Sell the crate loot you don't need: logs, ores, herbs, seeds.

edits.find: Camp Perilous Moons until Eclipse & Blood
edits.money: Moons of Peril gear is tradeable. Duplicate pieces are some of the best early money, so sell spares quickly, before more players arrive and prices fall.

edits.find: Water orbs: Make Battlestaffs & alch
edits.money: Compare the GE price of the battlestaves with their alch value. Early on, players may pay more than High Alchemy does.

edits.find: Complete barrows until you have Tank helm, Plate, Legs
edits.money: Sell every Barrows piece you won't wear. New players all want them.

edits.find: get your Enhanced Weapon Seed from Corrupted Gauntlet
edits.money: Enhanced weapon seeds and crystal armour seeds are among the most valuable early drops. Sell any extras.

edits.find: Alch your Rune & Dragon Items from Corrupted Gauntlet
edits.money: Check the GE before alching. Early on, players may pay more for rune and dragon items than High Alchemy does.

edits.find: Once you have a ring of suffering
edits.money: Zulrah is one of the best money makers in the game (tanzanite fang, magic fang, serpentine visage, onyx), and early drops are worth even more here. Every kill still risks a real death.
